reason: The text actually demonstrates the opposite of the statement. When Samuel fears revealing God's message to Eli, Eli explicitly commands Samuel to express the revelation without concealing anything, warning him with an oath ("אַל־ נָא תְכַחֵד מִמֶּנִּי" - 'do not hide from me'). Furthermore, the passage shows the elders of Israel actively expressing their collective judgment about their military defeat ("לָמָּה נְגָפָנוּ יְהוָה הַיּוֹם" - 'why has the LORD defeated us today?'), discussing strategy and seeking divine intervention. The passage encourages and depicts active expression of views rather than discouragement of it.
